methodology: Past 99 realized months per region, top-5 picks by model score vs their actual forward_return_h (≈21-session forward return). Hit rate = fraction of top picks that actually went up. Excess = top-picks mean return − all-stocks mean return that month. If the model is NULL (rank-IC −0.0088), hit rate ≈ base rate and excess ≈ 0. This is the honest 'prediction vs reality' audit.
